strings.name: Lady Gaga
strings.summary: Born Stefani Germanotta, Gaga studied at New York University before pursuing music professionally. Dance-pop, visual performance and changing stage identities brought fame. She also collaborated with Tony Bennett in jazz, starred in A Star Is Born and co-wrote its songs. She co-founded a foundation with her mother to support youth mental health and publicly advocates for LGBTQ rights.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Music and visual performance
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combines dance-pop, clothing, stage identities and imagery, also working in jazz and film music.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Youth mental health advocacy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded Born This Way Foundation with her mother, supporting youth mental health and anti-bullying work.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Mayhem wins Grammy
strings.timeline.t1.text: The album won Best Pop Vocal Album, while Abracadabra won Best Dance Pop Recording.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Releases Mayhem
strings.timeline.t2.text: Released a studio album combining dance and pop, continuing her stage and visual work.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Shallow wins Oscar
strings.timeline.t3.text: As a co-writer, won Best Original Song for the A Star Is Born song.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Stars in A Star Is Born
strings.timeline.t4.text: Co-starred with Bradley Cooper and contributed to writing and performing the film’s songs.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Foundation formally launched
strings.timeline.t5.text: Launched Born This Way Foundation with her mother at Harvard, focusing on young people’s wellbeing.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Releases Born This Way
strings.timeline.t6.text: Released an album exploring identity and self-acceptance, expanding her pop work.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Debut album The Fame
strings.timeline.t7.text: Entered the international pop market through her debut album and its dance singles.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Enters New York University
strings.timeline.t8.text: Trained at Tisch before leaving to pursue musical performance and songwriting.
